    2. Digital Dividend & Regulatory Reporting Transformation

    • MiKaDiv Execution: Support Product in the technical implementation and operational governance of MiKaDiv (Mitteilungsverfahren Kapitalertragsteuer auf Dividenden). Lead continuous data gathering throughout the custody chain, validate beneficial ownership timelines, and secure the electronic transmission paths required to fetch the mandatory unique tax reference numbers (UUIDs) from the BZSt.

    • NEK (Nichtentrichtete Kapitalertragsteuer): Manage reporting and exception workflows surrounding non-withheld or uncollectible capital gains tax (e.g., when an account lacks sufficient cash liquidity during a tax event like the Vorabpauschale), ensuring seamless reporting logs to the local tax offices via CPB.

    3. Customer Tax Exemptions & Account Adjustments

    • FSAk (Freistellungsauftrag / Kontrollverfahren): Support CPB with the submission and by running controls.

    • NV-Bescheinigungen: Validate, track, and audit Non-Assessment Certificates (Nichtveranlagungs-Bescheinigungen), ensuring proper single vs. joint application rules.

    • Loss Pot Management (Verlusttöpfe): Oversee the automated real-time logic of the Share Loss Pot (Aktienverlusttopf) and General Loss Pot (Allgemeiner Verlusttopf), cross-pot optimization offsets, and cross-border or marital Verlusttopf-Überträge (loss pot transfers) during account migrations or closures.

    • Deceased Account Backward Correction (Erbfall): Blueprint and implement the technical logic for backward tax corrections (rückwirkende Korrektur) in the event of an end-user's death, ensuring the immediate freeze and retro-active dissolution of exemption orders (FSA) and the automated cross-year recalculation/neutralization of loss pots (Verlusttöpfe) up to the exact date of death.

    • Church Tax Automation: Control the query process (KiStAM) to the BZSt, including ensuring the application of the correct split-tax formulas (Halbteilungsgrundsatz) to joint accounts with mixed religious denominations.

    4. Tax Documentation & Core IT Collaboration

    • Jahressteuerbescheinigung: Support CPB and Product in the flawless generation of the annual German tax certificate (Jahressteuerbescheinigung e.g., Erträgnisaufstellung), including complex edge cases for joint account primary address routing.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
description:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

The Parallax Cloud team builds the communication fabric that lets vehicles, mobile apps, and cloud services exchange live state and commands securely and reliably.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build and operate services and APIs that hide messaging, routing, and authorization complexity from product teams. This is hands-on platform work: you will solve distributed-systems problems, trace failures across the stack, and carry changes from design through production.

 

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate cloud services and gRPC/Protobuf APIs that let product teams read vehicle state, subscribe to changes, and send commands.

  • Operate and tune NATS, our high-performance messaging system, including configuration, upgrades, troubleshooting, performance validation, and capacity planning.

  • Own services end to end, from implementation through deployment and production operation, using Kubernetes, GitOps/Argo CD, and infrastructure as code.

  • Diagnose production behavior using metrics, traces, logs, dashboards, and alerts.

  • Design, operate, and tune service networking, load balancers, and L4/L7 traffic routing.

  • Develop and run end-to-end, integration, and load tests to catch functional and performance regressions before production.

 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • At least 5 years of software engineering experience focused on distributed systems, high-scale backend services, or streaming and messaging platforms.

  • Strong proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language and willingness to work primarily in Go, with occasional work in Java and TypeScript client SDKs.

  • Practical experience building and operating production services, including observability and troubleshooting.

  • Solid foundations in API design, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems with working knowledge of Kubernetes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with high-throughput messaging systems such as NATS, Kafka, or MQTT.

  • Experience with Kubernetes and owning service deployments; familiarity with GitOps/Argo CD and infrastructure as code.

  • Strong knowledge of HTTP/2, TCP, L4/L7 load balancing along with experience operating gRPC services in production is a major plus.

  • Familiarity with mTLS, certificates, service identity, secure transport and authentication patterns.

  • Track record of maintaining or making contributions to established open-source projects.

 

Why this role

Parallax Cloud engineers collaborate closely with both product and cloud platform teams, creating a unique opportunity to shape how connected features are designed and how the underlying platform evolves. The role offers broad visibility across the system and meaningful influence on decisions on both sides. You will have the autonomy to investigate problems and carry improvements from design through rollout.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs.

title: Head of Finance and Operations (m/w/d)
description:
Ninox ist eine Berliner Low-Code-Plattform, mit der Teams genau die Geschäftsanwendungen bauen, die sie brauchen. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende, tausende Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa, vom kleinen Team bis zum Großunternehmen. Ein Produkt, an dem Menschen wirklich hängen. Wir sind seit 12 Jahren am Markt, etabliert, wachsen und sind solide mit Wagniskapital finanziert.

Aufgaben

Du leitest Finance, IT, People und Operations: neun Menschen in vier Disziplinen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese vier Disziplinen zu führen, zu entwickeln und auf gemeinsame Standards, Servicelevel und Prioritäten auszurichten. Auch dort, wo du selbst nicht die Fachexpertin oder der Fachexperte bist. Gleichzeitig bist du Ansprechpartner für das C-Level (CEO, CGO und CRO) und die Teamleads in den anderen Abteilungen.

Der Schwerpunkt deiner Ergebnisverantwortung liegt dabei eindeutig im Finanzbereich. Dort führst du ein Team von vier Personen in der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung (AR/AP) und verantwortest den Rechnungslegungszyklus von Anfang bis Ende: Buchhaltung, Zahlungsläufe, Mahnwesen und Payroll bis hin zum abgeschlossenen Monat und den Zahlen, die das Haus verlassen. Du überschaust die Systeme, die diese Zahlen erzeugen – DATEV, Billing-Plattformen, CRM und Data Warehouse und bist in der Lage diese nach modernen KI basierten Standards miteinander zu verzahnen um ein fortlaufendes Reporting aufzubauen.

Es ist weder eine rein strategische noch eine rein operative Position. Für IT und Office führst du über Standards, Servicelevel und Prioritäten: Hardware, Onboarding, Compliance Standards wie ISO 27001 und 9001 sind dabei von dir zu koordinieren.

Unser CFO wechselt begleitend in ein Fractional-Modell und bleibt bei Board-, Finanzierungs- und Transaktionsthemen eng dabei, du bekommst also einen erfahrenen Sparringspartner, ohne dass jemand über deinem Tagesgeschäft sitzt.

Qualifikation

  • Mehrere Jahre in einer leitenden Finanzfunktion in einem wachsenden Unternehmen, mit eigener Verantwortung für den Monatsabschluss vom Buchungssatz bis zum Reporting. In einem Team dieser Größe ist die Führungskraft Spielertrainer:in: Du kannst die Arbeit auch selbst machen, wenn jemand ausfällt.
  • Solide deutsche Rechnungslegungspraxis – HGB, DATEV, Payroll und die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Steuerberater. Praktisch, nicht theoretisch.
  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast ein Team fachlich und disziplinarisch geführt – idealerweise in der Buchhaltung – und traust dir zu, auch für IT und People Standards zu setzen, ohne Sysadmin oder Arbeitsrechtlerin zu sein.
  • Sicherheit bei SaaS-Kennzahlen: ARR, MRR, Brutto- und Nettoretention, Rechnungsabgrenzung, Kohorten-Analyse und dem entsprechenden Reporting.
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung darin, einen manuellen Prozess durch einen echten zu ersetzen: ein Reporting, das sich selbst baut; eine Abstimmung, die keine Person mehr braucht. Du musst kein SQL schreiben, solltest aber über Data Warehouse, Billing-System und CRM sprechen können, ohne dafür einen Entwickler im Raum zu brauchen.
  • Deutsch verhandlungssicher – Arbeits- und Abschlusssprache in dieser Rolle – sowie fließendes Englisch.
  • Von Vorteil: Due Diligence, Audit oder eine Finanzierungsrunde von innen erlebt; Berührung mit Förderprogrammen wie GRW oder IBB.
  • Erfahrung mit verschiedenen Compliance Frameworks wie ISO, GRC, ISMS, etc. geben dir einen erheblichen Vorteil im Prozess.

Benefits

  • 100.000–120.000 € Grundgehalt je nach Erfahrung, dazu ein variabler Anteil, gekoppelt an eine Scorecard, die du mitgestaltest.
  • pot. Beteiligung an unserem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm (ESOP).
  • Ein echtes Mandat: vier Funktionen, neun Menschen und das Mandat Prozesse effektiv und wachstumsorientiert zu gestalten.
  • Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro am Monbijouplatz in Berlin-Mitte
  • 30 Urlaubstage, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, BVG Ticket und weitere Benefits
  • Ein Unternehmen, klein genug, dass deine Entscheidungen sichtbar sind, und groß genug, dass die sie echten Impact haben.

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze zu einem Prozess, den du in Ordnung gebracht hast: wie er vorher aussah, was du verändert hast und was es dich gekostet hat, es durchzusetzen. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht.

title: Customer Success Manager B2B (all genders)
description:
DEIN IMPACT - DEINE ROLLE

Als Customer Success Manager B2B (all genders) bist du die strategische und operative Vertrauensperson für unsere Businesskunden über den gesamten Kunden-Lebenszyklus hinweg. Du verstehst ihre Business-Ziele, gestaltest den Onboarding-Prozess und sorgst durch regelmäßige Check-ins sowie Vor-Ort-Besuche für eine maximale Produkt-Adoption. Mit deinem Growth Mindset erkennst du Upsell-Potenziale proaktiv, verringerst Churn-Risiken frühzeitig und gewinnst ehemals inaktive oder gekündigte Kunden durch gezielte Winback-Initiativen zurück.

Die Rolle im Detail:

  • Hauptansprechpartner*in für unsere B2B-Kunden von der Übergabe aus dem Vertrieb über das Onboarding bis zur langfristigen Betreuung.
  • Kontinuierliche Überwachung der Kundenzufriedenheit, frühzeitiges Erkennen von Churn-Risiken und Einleiten gezielter Gegenmaßnahmen.
  • Strategische Reaktivierung und Rückgewinnung von gekündigten oder inaktiven Accounts durch Ursachenanalyse und maßgeschneiderte Mehrwertangebote.
  • Planung und Durchführung regelmäßiger Kundenbesuche und Business Reviews zur Festigung der Kundenbeziehung und Sicherung einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.
  • Identifikation und Begleitung von Upsell- und Cross-Sell-Potenzialen im bestehenden Kundenportfolio.
  • Dokumentation in CRM- & CS-Tools sowie enge Abstimmung mit Support, Vertrieb und Produktmanagement zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Customer Journey.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

  • Einschlägige B2B-Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Customer Success Management, Account Management oder vertriebsnahem Relationship Management.
  • Retention- & Growth-Expertise: Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Churn-Reduktion, im Onboarding-Prozess und in der Identifikation von Upsell- & Winback-Chancen.
  • Beziehungsaufbau & Reisebereitschaft: Ausgeprägte Empathie, starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch sowie Freude an Vor-Ort-Kundenbesuchen.
  • Data-driven & CS-Mindset: Sicheres Verständnis für moderne CS-Kennzahlen (MRR, Churn Rate, Winback rate) und die Fähigkeit, daraus konkrete Handlungsstrategien abzuleiten.
  • Tech- & Tool-Know-how: Souveräner Umgang mit gängigen CRM-, Support- und Customer-Success-Plattformen

WAS DICH BEI UNS ERWARTET

  • Flexibility First: Vertrauensarbeitszeit, Remote Work und regelmäßige Workations im EU-Ausland für deinen perfekten Work-Life-Flow.
  • Maximum Ownership: Viel Raum für deine Ideen, abwechslungsreiche Tasks und echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1.
  • Uncapped Potential: Attraktives Base Salary gepaart mit einer leistungsorientierten Provision – du bestimmst dein Wachstum.
  • Diverse High-Performance Culture: Ein internationales Team, das Vielfalt feiert, Synergien nutzt und gemeinsam Bestleistungen erzielt.
  • First-Class Perks: Bis zu 30 Tage Urlaub, exklusive Corporate Discounts, bAV mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss und ein High-End-HQ mitten auf der Berliner Friedrichstraße.

ÜBER TIGER

VON TIGER FACILITY SERVICES ZU GOODWORKVIBES
Sagen wir es, wie es ist: Die verstaubte B2B-Reinigungsbranche ist seit Jahrzehnten geprägt von weichgespültem Corporate-Talk, billigen Ausreden und null Transparenz. Damit ist jetzt Schluss.
Als Teil der The Helpling Group haben wir unter dem Namen Tiger Facility Services jahrelang bewiesen, wie man Tausende B2B-Kunden in Büros, Praxen und Agenturen mit maximaler operativer Präzision begeistert. Aber der moderne Arbeitsplatz hat sich verändert – und wir verpassen der gesamten Branche das längst überfällige Upgrade: Aus Tiger Facility Services wird GoodWorkVibes.

Warum wir das machen?
Weil ein Büro heute kein sterbenslangweiliger Raum mehr ist, in dem man Stunden absitzt. Es ist das Fundament für Employer Branding, Team-Performance und echte Workplace Culture. Wir verbinden unsere unerschütterliche operative Brutalität im Hintergrund (Powered by Tiger Standard) mit dem feinsten Corporate Punk-Sound, den die Arbeitswelt je gesehen hat.

Was die Branche und unsere Kunden zu erwarten haben?
Wir stellen das bestehende System auf den Kopf. Wir ersetzen stumme Putzkolonnen durch direkte Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe, digitale Transparenz und ein Betreuungskonzept, das Kunden zu echten Fans macht. Bei uns bist du kein austauschbarer „Reklamationsabwickler“, sondern der strategische Partner für Office Manager und C-Level. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Verträge nicht nur bestehen bleiben, sondern wachsen – weil unsere Kunden den Vibe in ihrem Büro nie wieder hergeben wollen.
Wenn du keinen Bock mehr auf reaktiven Support und klassische B2B-Sackgassen hast, sondern im Customer Success echte Maßstäbe setzen willst, bist du bei GoodWorkVibes genau richtig.

title: Mechatronics Engineering - 50 Prozent studentische Stelle (m/w/d)
description:
XRbit is a research insitute developing innovative at the intersection of technology, science and digital learning.

Our interdisciplinary team combines software development, artificial intelligence, Extended Reality (XR), 3D technologies and interactive systems. We work together with universities, research institutions, educational organizations, museums and other partners to develop new ways of making complex topics accessible and tangible.

As our research and development activities increasingly combine software with physical systems, we are looking for someone who enjoys turning ideas into working hardware prototypes.

Aufgaben

You will develop and prototype hardware systems at the intersection of camera technology, embedded computing, sensor technology, mechanics and robotics.

A key part of your work will be the development of camera-based systems for computer vision and AI applications.

These systems may range from laboratory prototypes to robust systems intended for continuous operation in industrial or outdoor environments.

You will work closely with our software, AI and 3D development teams and help bridge the gap between software and the physical world.

Your tasks may include:

  • Designing, building and testing camera-based hardware systems
  • Integrating embedded computing platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi or comparable systems
  • Programming and connecting sensors, cameras, microcontrollers and other electronic components
  • Developing suitable concepts for thermal management, ventilation and condensation prevention
  • Producing prototype components using 3D printing and rapid prototyping
  • Documenting hardware architectures, components and technical decisions

Qualifikation

Your Profile

You should have a background in one or more of the following areas:

  • Mechatronics
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Embedded Systems
  • Automation Engineering
  • or a comparable technical field

Technical Skills

You should have practical experience with several of the following areas:

  • Programming C and/or C++ as well as Python
  • Embedded systems/ Microcontrollers
  • Linux-based systems
  • Cameras and image acquisition
  • 3D printing or other rapid-prototyping technologies

Most importantly, you should be comfortable combining software, electronics and mechanics into a working physical system.

Additional Experience That Would Be Valuable

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage, but is not required:

  • Machine Vision
  • Robotics/ Servo motors and stepper motors
  • PCB design
  • Electronics prototyping
  • Ruggedized electronics
  • Thermal management of embedded systems

Benefits

You will become part of an interdisciplinary environment where hardware development is closely connected to artificial intelligence, software development, 3D technologies and applied research.

We offer:

  • A technically diverse student position combining software and hardware development
  • Practical work on real-world prototypes rather than purely theoretical concepts
  • Direct involvement in research and development activities
  • Work with modern technologies in embedded systems, computer vision, AI and robotics
  • Access to prototyping and development infrastructure
  • Close collaboration with an interdisciplinary development team
  • A combination of on-site development work and remote work
  • Opportunities to develop your own technical ideas and contribute to prototype design

We are particularly interested in people who enjoy building things.

You should be comfortable moving from an initial idea to a first experimental setup, testing it, identifying problems and improving the system step by step.

For example, you might spend one day programming an embedded computer, another day testing a camera and lens combination, and the next day designing and 3D-printing a new enclosure or mounting system.

You do not need to be an expert in every technology listed above.

We value curiosity, technical creativity, structured problem-solving and the willingness to experiment with different approaches.

Personal or university projects involving robotics, electronics, embedded systems, drones, cameras, 3D printers, automation or similar technologies are very welcome and can be just as relevant as professional experience.

Interested?

Please send your application, CV and – if available – examples or short descriptions of technical projects you have worked on (GitHub repositories, project documentation, CAD models etc.)

Please only include information in your application that you consider relevant to your professional qualifications and experience.

XRbit welcomes applications from all qualified candidates. Selection is based on professional qualifications, relevant experience, skills and suitability for the position.

You'll own features from concept to handoff and create polished, engaging, habit-forming interfaces. This role is about designing experiences that perform. You’ll work at the intersection of user behavior, data, and business goals, shaping flows that drive engagement and revenue. Your work reaches over 25 million users and feeds directly into experimentation and iteration, letting you see the real impact of your decisions. At exmox, we're also embracing AI as part of how we work, not just what we build. We use AI tools to work smarter, cut down on repetitive tasks and spend our time where it actually moves the needle. If that mindset speaks to you, you'll fit right in.

Our product design team is growing in maturity, and you’ll play a key role in shaping how design works at exmox. If you want high impact, real ownership, and a product at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Own:

  • Feature ownership: Own and design new features from concept through final handoff.
  • UI design: Design visually engaging and highly polished interfaces for our B2C mobile app.
  • Visual assets: Create illustrations, icons, and other graphical assets to support your designs.

  • Research collaboration: Work closely with UX research and data teams to evaluate and improve your designs.
  • Iteration & feedback: Gather feedback and continuously refine and improve your work.

What’s in it for you as a designer?

  • Impact: Your work directly influences a product used by millions. You’ll see the effect of your design decisions on business KPIs and learn how to create value through design.
  • Data-driven culture: Data sits at the core of every decision we make. You’ll design, test, and iterate based on real user insights and performance metrics.
  • Large global user base: You’ll design for a product with over 25 million users worldwide, operating at true scale.
  • Growing design maturity: Our product design team is on a journey to elevate design maturity at exmox, and you’ll actively shape and contribute to that evolution.
  • Cross-functional design team: You’ll collaborate within a dedicated design team including Product designers, UI Designers, and UX Researcher.

What You Bring

  • Portfolio: A portfolio showcasing outstanding mobile UI craft and visual design.
  • Professional experience: 5+ years of experience working in product teams as a UI, UI/UX, or Product Designer.
  • Consumer product design: Experience designing habit-forming, engaging, consumer-facing interfaces.
  • Industry background: Experience in marketing, gaming, or other B2C-heavy industries is a plus.

Hard Skills:

  • Design tools: Strong proficiency in Figma.
  • Motion & interaction design: Expertise in motion design, animation, and transitions to craft dynamic interfaces.
  • Visual asset creation: Expertise in creating illustrations, iconography, and other visual assets.
  • Design systems: Expertise in designing, shipping, and maintaining design systems.
  • Multi-brand products: Experience with multi-brand, white-label products and theming systems.
  • Brand identity: Experience in defining, designing, and documenting brand identities.
  • Copywriting: Experience in copywriting, including defining tone, voice, and messaging.
  • Accessibility & usability: Strong knowledge of accessibility and usability principles.
  • Frontend awareness: Understanding of front-end technologies and implementation constraints.
  • Language skills: Fluency in English; German is a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Ownership: You take full responsibility for your work, drive initiatives forward, align stakeholders, and ensure meaningful value delivery.
  • Proactiveness: You anticipate challenges, identify opportunities, and take initiative without waiting for direction.
  • Prioritisation: You focus on what matters most, balance speed and quality, and manage your workload effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Feedback mindset: You give constructive feedback thoughtfully and embrace feedback as an essential part of iteration and growth, comfortably navigating multiple refinement cycles.
  • Creative thinking: You explore a wide range of ideas and solutions from safe bets to bold, out-of-the-box concepts to achieve the most impactful outcome.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

title: Senior Manager Logistics & Supply Chain (f/m/d)
description:
About Us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.

About Our Technology

The semiconductor industry's growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude. In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.

The Role

At Black Semiconductor, logistics is more than moving materials from A to B. It is the infrastructure that keeps our operations running as we move towards production, it is becoming increasingly business-critical.

We are looking for a Senior Manager to take ownership of this function and help build it for our next stage of growth. This is a role for someone who enjoys both getting things done and building them up properly: you will participate in day-to-day operations, while at the same time developing the processes, structures and supply chain setup we need for the future.

Today, our logistics setup is very lean, giving you significant ownership from day one. With the setup and scaling of our main headquarters and new facility (FabONE), you will play a key role in scaling Black Semiconductor’s our operational capabilities as the company moves into production. You will work closely with our core business units to develop a reliable supply chain and strengthen compliance.

To Join Our Team, You Should Be Excited To:

  • Build and lead the logistics team and warehouse operations, providing both functional and disciplinary leadership.

  • To keep products moving, ensure reliable day-to-day logistics operations across domestic and international transportation, shipping and distribution, taking a hands-on approach where needed.

  • Develop and optimize end-to-end supply chain processes across warehousing, receiving, inventory, transportation, shipping and production support.

  • Drive initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, cost performance and delivery reliability, like our SAP S/4HANA rollout, establishing RASIC and best practices to building the team and capabilities needed for future growth.

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders across production, engineering, procurement and other business functions to ensure a reliable flow of materials and information.

  • Own dangerous goods handling and regulatory compliance, ensuring adherence to ADR, IATA, IMDG, and all relevant legal requirements

  • Ensure that compliance is an integral part of our logistics and supply chain processes right from the start.

Your Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in logistics, supply chain or warehouse management, import/export or manufacturing operations

  • At least 4 years of disciplinary leadership and people management experience, ideally with responsibility for teams with 5+ employees

  • Experience in a startup/scale-up environment or complex corporate organization, ideally in semiconductor, pharmaceutical or another highly regulated industry

  • Deep expertise in supply chain management, material flow, inventory management, production support and import/export regulations

  • Strong hands-on experience with WMS and ERP systems (SAP/S/4HANA experience is a plus)

  • Proven expertise in dangerous goods, German regulatory requirements and compliance, ideally combined with cleanroom logistics experience

  • A pragmatic leadership mindset, strategic thinking, and strong problem-solving as well as stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluent German language skills (minimum: C1) and good English (minimum: B2)

What Makes This Role Different

Rather than maintaining existing playbooks, this is your chance to build a modern logistics function from the ground up. You will have the opportunity to shape the function from an early stage and define how logistics and supply chains should work at Black Semiconductor.

Your decisions will have a direct impact on our ability to operate, produce and scale. You will have the freedom to bring your expertise, challenge existing ways of working and build the team, processes and standards you believe are needed.

If you enjoy combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, taking ownership and building something that will grow with the company, this is an opportunity to make a real difference.

Our Work Culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters.

Let's Grow Together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development.

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority — in the present and future.

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward.

We connect chips — and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry.

title: Senior Post-Market Surveillance Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Company & Role Overview 

About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. 

Role overview

As Post-Market Surveillance Manager, you'll build and run our global post-market surveillance system — from complaint handling and adverse-event reporting to data trending and governance — and lead its rollout across Customer Support, QA, Regulatory, Engineering, Clinical, and Product. This is a hands-on role: you'll turn post-market insights into action that improves product quality, patient safety, and the customer experience, drawing on strong judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to influence stakeholders globally. 

Requirements

Core responsibilities

  • Design, build, and run our global post-market surveillance system — complaint handling, adverse-event/vigilance reporting, escalation, and governance — staying hands-on for complex or high-risk cases
  • Own the complaint-to-report pipeline: reportability assessments and timely, accurate adverse-event/vigilance submissions across markets (US, EU, and others)
  • Build the KPIs, dashboards, and trending methods that surface safety, quality, and customer-experience signals — and turn findings into action via CAPA, risk management, product/software fixes, and labeling updates
  • Lead the cross-functional rollout — implementation plans, priorities, dependencies, and risk — to build sustainable post-market processes and infrastructure
  • Present post-market performance and recommendations to leadership, and support PMS reports, PSURs, and management reviews 
  • Act as SME during audits and inspections, and guide internal teams and external partners on post-market activities 

Background & Experience

  • 7+ years in medical-device post-market surveillance, complaint handling, quality, or regulatory affairs, including leading process implementations 
  • At least a bachelor's degree
  • Hands-on experience with complaint investigations, reportability assessments, and regulatory submissions (FDA MDR, EU MDR vigilance/PMS, ISO 13485, ISO 14971), plus post-market data analysis
  • Program management skills — workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies — plus an analytical mindset for turning complaint data into risk-based recommendations 
  • Strong communicator, comfortable influencing cross-functional teams, leadership, and regulators
  • Hands-on, independent leadership style; able to scale processes as we grow
  • Nice to have: experience with additional international markets or digital complaint-management systems

What success looks like

  • Scalable processes for complaint intake, investigation, and resolution — with clear escalation pathways to ensure adverse events and reportable incidents are identified, assessed, and reported within regulatory timeline
  • Customer Support consistently identifies, documents, and escalates complaints and potential safety events, thanks to close partnership and training
  • KPIs and dashboards give clear visibility into complaint timeliness, resolution, regulatory reporting, and emerging trends
  • Post-market insights translate into action — product improvements, CAPAs, risk-management updates, and a better customer experience

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You let data and clarity guide your decisions, and you take accountability for results. You're a difference maker — you drive ideas to commercial success from start to end 

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with quality. You treat feedback as a chance to learn, and you're deep in customer and partner feedback — translating it to action quickly

Team First — You collaborate effectively across teams and build trust through clarity and respect. You're comfortable bridging local execution with a global team, and you communicate openly across time zones

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location)

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

description:
About Us

STARK is a defence technology company redefining the engineering and deployment of autonomous platforms. Our core mission is to deliver fully operational unmanned systems, integrating the critical subsystems, including Electronic Warfare, necessary for NATO forces to maintain a decisive advantage in contested environments. We do whatever is required to achieve platform autonomy, grounded in precision, responsibility, and uncompromising engineering discipline.

Your mission

At STARK, we are building the next generation of autonomous platforms capable of navigating the world's most contested environments. As a Senior Mesh Network and MAC Engineer you will solve the critical challenges of directional wireless communication in highly dynamic networks. You will design and implement the medium access control (MAC) and routing layers that allow our platforms to form robust, self-healing networks under demanding tactical conditions.


Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement MAC protocols and routing algorithms tailored for directional multi-node systems, directly tackling the challenge of neighbour discovery under highly focused, narrow beams.
  • Build dynamic TDMA schedules and beam coordination mechanisms in lockstep with the physical layer (PHY) and antenna steering systems, ensuring routing decisions are grounded in real-time RF characteristics rather than simple hop counts.
  • Deliver resilient multi-hop relay capabilities that sustain high-bandwidth video and control links between mobile platforms over tactical distances, routing back seamlessly to ground control stations under dynamic conditions.
  • Build and maintain multi-node Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testbeds alongside automated logging pipelines to quantitatively evaluate and verify network join times and topology reform behaviours.
  • Mesh networking in a product that shipped — sim work alone does not qualify — plus Linux networking at kernel and packet level with live debugging.
  • Radio-literate and has designed a medium-access scheme or TDMA schedule.


Qualifications

  • You have successfully designed and shipped mesh networking protocols in commercial or defence products.
  • Deep, practical familiarity with the Linux networking stack at the kernel and packet levels, coupled with strong live-debugging skills on embedded systems.
  • Strong understanding of wireless propagation and physical layer realities, with hands-on experience designing medium-access control schemes or TDMA schedulers.


Nice to have

  • Active contributions to open-source routing protocols (e.g., batman-adv, olsrd, Babel).

title: SRE Manager
description:
About Us

Parity is one of the world's most experienced core blockchain infrastructure companies, having built and pioneered some of the most advanced technologies in the blockchain sector. Parity was founded by Dr. Gavin Wood, co-founder and former CTO of Ethereum, the primary engineer behind the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), inventor of the Solidity programming language, and primary author of the Ethereum Yellowpaper.

People in Our Collective Are

  • Highly motivated to contribute to Parity’s mission and be part of something bigger

  • Excited to work on projects that are groundbreaking and complex

  • Autonomous workers that self-initiate, but also collaborate well with others

  • Taking maximum accountability and having minimum ego at work

  • Comfortable with chaos and adapting to the ever-changing Web3 space

  • Continuously educating themselves about Parity and the wider ecosystem

About the Team

The SRE team is responsible for the infrastructure that makes the Polkadot platform and technology work: test and production network environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and the systems that developers, node operators, and end-user applications across the ecosystem rely on. This spans the full stack from runtime and parachain development environments through to infrastructure supporting live applications and events.

We run environments at different stability tiers, from fast-moving test networks with daily automated updates to production networks with 24/7 on-call coverage. It's a small team, so the role carries broad scope.

The Role

We're looking for an engineering manager who can lead a team of experienced SRE engineers and raise the standard of what reliability looks like in a blockchain infrastructure context.

The team is technically capable. What it needs is someone who can set engineering direction, build the conditions for good work, and think clearly about reliability as a discipline: SLOs, error budgets, blameless postmortems.

What We're Looking For

Systems thinking. You have a genuine understanding of distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure. You don't need to be the most senior engineer technically, but you need to be credible to people who are.

Reliability. You've worked in or led a team that takes SRE seriously. You know what error budgets are actually for, when SLOs are miscalibrated, and how to run postmortems that improve things.

Automation. You get uncomfortable when skilled engineers spend time on work a machine could do. You've built teams that automate away the repetitive work rather than just absorbing it.

People development. You have a track record of engineers growing under your leadership, ideally some of them moving on to bigger things.

Comfort with unusual territory. Blockchain infrastructure has properties that don't map cleanly onto standard cloud operations. You don't need prior Web3 experience, but you shouldn't be put off by it either.

Working at Parity

Remote-first, with offices in Berlin, Lisbon, and London. Parity is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome.

title: IT Systems Engineer
description:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.

The Role

We're hiring a IT Systems Engineer to own the reliability and evolution of the tools every team at OLIX depends on day to day: identity and SSO, device management across Mac and Windows, Google Workspace, and the wider collaboration and business-systems stack including Slack, Notion and Atlassian. As headcount grows, so does the load on these systems, and we need someone to own their architecture and roadmap rather than just keep them running.

You'll be the final escalation point for complex, cross-system problems, and you'll lead company-wide systems projects from scoping through delivery. A significant identity provider and device management migration is on the near-term roadmap, so there's substantial architectural work from day one.

Beyond the core stack, you'll act as OLIX's AI enabler: finding the manual tools and processes worth removing, evaluating tools, and building agents and automations that act as a force multiplier across the business, all while holding a high bar on security and IP protection. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with the freedom to define how IT and internal systems work here from the ground up.

Responsibilities

  • Strengthen the core stack: own the architecture and roadmap for our business-systems stack, including IDP/IAM, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Atlassian and adjacent HRIS, ATS and finance platforms, and make sure they scale ahead of OLIX's growth.

  • Lead IT and systems projects end to end: take medium-to-large, company-wide projects from scoping through delivery, automating recurring work, streamlining tooling, and improving the day-one and day-to-day experience for every OLIX employee.

  • Be the escalation point: act as the final escalation point for complex, cross-system issues, providing expert-level root cause analysis and implementing architectural changes that stop problems recurring.

  • Build agents and automations: champion AI adoption across the business, partnering with functional teams to design scalable, automated processes and building the tools, scripts and workflows (Google Workspace and Apps Script, IDP APIs) that eliminate manual toil.

  • Own secure onboarding of new tools: partner with InfoSec on SaaS vendor reviews and rollout, so new tools arrive with SSO, SCIM and least-privilege access in place.

  • Raise the bar as you go: find and fix friction or quality gaps in how IT and systems operate without being asked, mentor others, and be a visible example of ownership in the team.

Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years in IT systems engineering, with a track record of owning systems end to end rather than working tickets within someone else's design.

  • Expert-level knowledge of Windows and Mac device management, Google Workspace administration, and Google Cloud Identity across users, devices and applications.

  • Deep, hands-on experience with SSO and identity platforms, ideally Okta, OneLogin, JumpCloud. Experience rebuilding or migrating between identity providers is a strong plus given our roadmap.

  • Experience administering SaaS and collaboration tools at company scale, Slack, Notion and Atlassian (Jira/Confluence) in particular.

  • An AI-first mindset: a practical focus on using AI and LLM-powered tools to streamline IT operations, improve user self-service and automate repetitive work, and a habit of building agents that act as force multipliers for the business.

  • Coding and scripting experience in one or more general-purpose languages, plus familiarity with Google Workspace developer tools (Apps Script, Workspace APIs).

  • Solid grasp of IT security fundamentals: role-based access control, least-privilege access, MDM, data security and identity best practice.

  • Proven ownership: a track record of taking ambiguous, medium-to-large problems and driving them to durable resolution without heavy oversight.

Nice to have: exposure to a fast-moving hardware or deep-tech startup, and comfort with infrastructure-as-code-style change management culture.

Compensation & Equity

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location

  • Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You're not just joining the mission; you're owning a piece of it

  • Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office

  • Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security.

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates' eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

You will play a key role, working directly with our Head of Privacy, in maintaining and promoting a culture of privacy and security within the organization.   • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across legal and business teams

title: Senior Sales Engineer

description:
About Us

Parity is one of the world's most experienced core blockchain infrastructure companies, having built and pioneered some of the most advanced technologies in the blockchain sector. Parity was founded by Dr. Gavin Wood, co-founder and former CTO of Ethereum, the primary engineer behind the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), inventor of the Solidity programming language, and primary author of the Ethereum Yellowpaper.

People in Our Collective Are

  • Highly motivated to contribute to Parity’s mission and be part of something bigger

  • Excited to work on projects that are groundbreaking and complex

  • Autonomous workers that self-initiate, but also collaborate well with others

  • Taking maximum accountability and having minimum ego at work

  • Comfortable with chaos and adapting to the ever-changing Web3 space

  • Continuously educating themselves about Parity and the wider ecosystem

About the Team

The SRE team is responsible for the infrastructure that makes the Polkadot platform and technology work: test and production network environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and the systems that developers, node operators, and end-user applications across the ecosystem rely on. This spans the full stack from runtime and parachain development environments through to infrastructure supporting live applications and events.

We run environments at different stability tiers, from fast-moving test networks with daily automated updates to production networks with 24/7 on-call coverage. It's a small team, so the role carries broad scope.

The Role

We're looking for an engineering manager who can lead a team of experienced SRE engineers and raise the standard of what reliability looks like in a blockchain infrastructure context.

The team is technically capable. What it needs is someone who can set engineering direction, build the conditions for good work, and think clearly about reliability as a discipline: SLOs, error budgets, blameless postmortems.

What We're Looking For

Systems thinking. You have a genuine understanding of distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure. You don't need to be the most senior engineer technically, but you need to be credible to people who are.

Reliability. You've worked in or led a team that takes SRE seriously. You know what error budgets are actually for, when SLOs are miscalibrated, and how to run postmortems that improve things.

Automation. You get uncomfortable when skilled engineers spend time on work a machine could do. You've built teams that automate away the repetitive work rather than just absorbing it.

People development. You have a track record of engineers growing under your leadership, ideally some of them moving on to bigger things.

Comfort with unusual territory. Blockchain infrastructure has properties that don't map cleanly onto standard cloud operations. You don't need prior Web3 experience, but you shouldn't be put off by it either.

Working at Parity

Remote-first, with offices in Berlin, Lisbon, and London. Parity is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome.

title: Senior Post-Market Surveillance Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Company & Role Overview 

About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. 

Role overview

As Post-Market Surveillance Manager, you'll build and run our global post-market surveillance system — from complaint handling and adverse-event reporting to data trending and governance — and lead its rollout across Customer Support, QA, Regulatory, Engineering, Clinical, and Product. This is a hands-on role: you'll turn post-market insights into action that improves product quality, patient safety, and the customer experience, drawing on strong judgment, disciplined execution, and the ability to influence stakeholders globally. 

Requirements

  • Design, build, and run our global post-market surveillance system — complaint handling, adverse-event/vigilance reporting, escalation, and governance — staying hands-on for complex or high-risk cases

  • Build the KPIs, dashboards, and trending methods that surface safety, quality, and customer-experience signals — and turn findings into action via CAPA, risk management, product/software fixes, and labeling updates
  • Lead the cross-functional rollout — implementation plans, priorities, dependencies, and risk — to build sustainable post-market processes and infrastructure
  • Present post-market performance and recommendations to leadership, and support PMS reports, PSURs, and management reviews 
  • Act as SME during audits and inspections, and guide internal teams and external partners on post-market activities 

Background & Experience

  • 7+ years in medical-device post-market surveillance, complaint handling, quality, or regulatory affairs, including leading process implementations 
  • At least a bachelor's degree
  • Hands-on experience with complaint investigations, reportability assessments, and regulatory submissions (FDA MDR, EU MDR vigilance/PMS, ISO 13485, ISO 14971), plus post-market data analysis
  • Program management skills — workstreams, stakeholders, dependencies — plus an analytical mindset for turning complaint data into risk-based recommendations 
  • Strong communicator, comfortable influencing cross-functional teams, leadership, and regulators
  • Hands-on, independent leadership style; able to scale processes as we grow
  • Nice to have: experience with additional international markets or digital complaint-management systems

What success looks like

  • Scalable processes for complaint intake, investigation, and resolution — with clear escalation pathways to ensure adverse events and reportable incidents are identified, assessed, and reported within regulatory timeline
  • Customer Support consistently identifies, documents, and escalates complaints and potential safety events, thanks to close partnership and training
  • KPIs and dashboards give clear visibility into complaint timeliness, resolution, regulatory reporting, and emerging trends
  • Post-market insights translate into action — product improvements, CAPAs, risk-management updates, and a better customer experience

Benefits

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You let data and clarity guide your decisions, and you take accountability for results. You're a difference maker — you drive ideas to commercial success from start to end 

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with quality. You treat feedback as a chance to learn, and you're deep in customer and partner feedback — translating it to action quickly

Team First — You collaborate effectively across teams and build trust through clarity and respect. You're comfortable bridging local execution with a global team, and you communicate openly across time zones

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company

Votre Rôle

Au sein de l'équipe B2B France, vous contribuez au développement et à l’engagement de notre réseau de professionnels de santé en construisant et pilotant des activations B2B adaptées aux besoins du marché français.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les Regional Managers afin d’identifier les besoins du terrain, de les transformer en initiatives pertinentes et, lorsque cela est possible, de les déployer à l’échelle du réseau.

  • Construire et piloter le plan d’activation B2B en définissant un calendrier annuel de campagnes, programmes et initiatives destinés aux professionnels de santé, en lien avec les priorités business

  • Concevoir les parcours partenaires en développant les parcours d’onboarding, d’engagement, de développement et de réactivation adaptés aux différents profils et niveaux de maturité des professionnels

  • Développer des programmes d’engagement et de développement du réseau, notamment autour de campagnes thématiques, lancements produits, réactivation, challenges, formations ou initiatives saisonnières

  • Piloter le déploiement des programmes en collaboration avec les Regional Managers vous déployez les initiatives auprès des partenaires, recueillez leurs retours et adaptez les dispositifs aux besoins du terrain

  • Développer l’activation CRM B2B en segmentant la base de professionnels et en mettant en place des communications et scénarios permettant d’accompagner les partenaires tout au long de leur parcours

  • Mesurer la performance des activations et identifier les opportunités d’amélioration, afin d’optimiser continuellement l’engagement du réseau et leur contribution au développement du marché français

Votre Profil

  • Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation avec orientation scientifique (nutrition, biologie, santé ou domaine similaire) et vous disposez d’une première expérience en marketing ou gestion de projet

  • Vous avez une réelle capacité à comprendre, synthétiser et vulgariser des informations scientifiques et à les transformer en contenus clairs, pédagogiques et pertinents pour des professionnels de santé

  • Vous êtes organisé(e), autonome et capable de piloter plusieurs projets simultanément, tout en coordonnant différentes parties prenantes

  • Vous avez une approche à la fois analytique et orientée business : vous savez identifier les priorités, mesurer les résultats et transformer les apprentissages en actions concrètes

  • Vous aimez travailler de manière transverse et savez transformer des besoins provenant du terrain en solutions structurées et scalables

title: Principal Thermo-Mechanical Engineer- Paris/Grenoble
description:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Asys, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal solutions management and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.Ingénieur / Ingénieure principal/e en thermomécanique (H/F) — Paris/Grenoble

    À propos de Vinci

    Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants.

    C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes.

    Présentation du poste

    En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l'adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d'ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d'accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel.

    En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d'améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché.

    Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la mécanique des milieux continus, vous guiderez l'analyse de phénomènes physiques complexes : comportements linéaires, non-linéarités géométriques et matérielles, et interactions de contact. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que le warpage, l'évolution des contraintes, le cyclage thermique et la fiabilité, sur des composants semi-conducteurs avancés, des packages électroniques et des systèmes à l'échelle du wafer.

    Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d'usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d'interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

    Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l'équipe américaine.

    Responsabilités

    • Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d'ingénieur/es en thermomécanique, en définissant l'orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l'équipe, et en pilotant l'exécution sur le terrain à travers l'Europe.

    • Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations de produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels.

    • Accompagner les équipes d'ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d'évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l'exécution de cas de test complexes et l'interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci.

    • Piloter l'accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l'onboarding, le déploiement et l'expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes.

    • Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés.

    • Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d'événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme.

    • Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci.

    Qualifications (Qualifications minimales)

    Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié.

    Expertise technique : Maîtrise approfondie de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Ansys, Abaqus ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d'expérience pratique en simulation thermomécanique — que ce soit en réalisant vous-même des simulations ou dans une fonction de Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique.

    Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies.

    Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées client, avec une forte capacité à établir une relation de confiance et à gérer des relations avec des équipes d'ingénierie côté client.

    Automatisation & scripting : Expérience pratique en programmation avec Python ou C++ pour automatiser des flux de travail ou analyser des données issues de simulations.

    Leadership : Expérience avérée en management ou en leadership technique, avec la capacité à développer une équipe, accompagner ses membres et piloter l'exécution au sein d'équipes d'ingénierie.

    Communication : Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, avec une capacité démontrée à transformer des résultats complexes de physique et de simulation en messages clairs et à fort impact, aussi bien pour des publics techniques de haut niveau que pour des directions non spécialistes.

    Profil recherché (Atouts différenciants)

    Expertise multiphysique : Connaissance de la gestion thermique et des solutions de refroidissement et/ou des flux de travail Signal Integrity et Power Integrity (SI/PI).

    Expérience commerciale : Expérience directe dans la commercialisation de logiciels techniques — idéalement des outils d'Electronic Design Automation (EDA) ou de simulation CAE — auprès de grandes entreprises des secteurs des semi-conducteurs et de l'électronique.

    Parcours Go-to-Market : Passage préalable par des fonctions de pré-vente technique, d'ingénierie applicative (FAE) ou de vente technique stratégique.

    Technologies émergentes : Capacité à adopter rapidement et à promouvoir des flux de travail de nouvelle génération fondés sur la physique, ainsi que des outils de conception ou de simulation assistés par l'IA.

    Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

    • Ne vous contentez pas d'utiliser l'IA : rejoignez une équipe qui redéfinit activement la manière dont le silicium et les systèmes hardware de nouvelle génération sont conçus.

    • Travaillez à la convergence de modèles d'IA de pointe, de la physique fondamentale et de projets industriels à forts enjeux.

    • Collaborez avec des équipes d'ingénierie et de recherche de renommée mondiale, dans un environnement de start-up en forte croissance.

    Lieu : Paris ou Grenoble, France

    Type d'emploi : Temps plein

    Mode de travail : Télétravail

    Département : Commercial

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build.

This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments.

Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our Paris office.

About the Role

Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes.

You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.

This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com.

What You'll Do

Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout.

Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there.

Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself.

Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim.

Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion.

What we promise

This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome-based success criteria agreed before the build starts.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building applications from scratch using TypeScript/Node.js/React, with full-stack depth

  • Experience leading hands-on projects end-to-end in a production environment, preferably client-facing

  • Background in Solution Architecture or Software Engineering with a strong grasp of AI/LLM systems: agent architectures, MCP or comparable tool-use protocols, evals, and prompt-to-production workflows

  • Experience navigating C-suite relationships and influencing executive decisions in ambiguous environments

  • Track record of turning one-off delivery work into reusable assets, product requirements, or repeatable playbooks

  • Entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and focused on long-term impact over immediate fixes

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Intégré(e) au sein du pôle E-commerce et rattaché(e) au Lead Data Science & Analytics, vous accompagnerez l’équipe dans les sujets du quotidien ainsi que dans la construction de projets dédiés. Vous serez amené(e)s à travailler sur les sujets suivants :

Data Analyse

Vous serez un(e) membre à part entière de l'équipe Data Science & Analytics et participerez activement à son quotidien :

  • Analyses Ad Hoc : Vous mènerez diverses analyses ponctuelles indispensables pour affiner notre compréhension de nos marques, de la performance de nos produits et du comportement de nos client(e)s.

  • Accompagnement Marketing : Vous participerez aux opérations courantes en réalisant des extractions de données ciblées pour nos initiatives marketing. Cela inclut la mise en place de groupes de contrôle rigoureux et la mesure de la performance incrémentale de ces campagnes.
